units.source_text: 还有件奇怪的事儿，我对玻璃公司老板嘎尔怀有莫名的好感。

en.t: There was another strange thing: I felt an inexplicable fondness for Gael, the owner of the glass company.

units.source_text: 嘎尔是数一数二的大资本家。

en.t: Gael was one of the foremost great capitalists.

units.source_text: 整个河童国的全部河童里，嘎尔的肚皮是最大的。

en.t: Among all the kappa in the whole country of kappa, Gael had the biggest belly.

units.source_text: 他坐在扶手椅上，周围簇拥着长得像荔枝的老婆和长得像黄瓜的孩子。

en.t: He sat in an armchair, surrounded by his lychee-like wife and his cucumber-like children.

units.source_text: 审判官培卟和医生查喀去嘎尔家吃晚饭的时候时常会带上我。

en.t: When Judge Pepp and Doctor Chack went to Gael's house for dinner, they often took me along.

units.source_text: 我还曾经带着嘎尔的介绍信，去参观与嘎尔和他的朋友多少有些关系的各种各样的工厂，

en.t: I also once carried a letter of introduction from Gael and went to tour various factories that had some connection with Gael and his friends,

units.source_text: 其中印制书籍的工厂最吸引我。

en.t: and among them the factory that printed books attracted me the most.

units.source_text: 我和一位年轻的河童工程师一起进入工厂，

en.t: I entered the factory together with a young kappa engineer,

units.source_text: 看到依靠水力发电运转的大机器时，

en.t: and when I saw the great machines running on hydroelectric power,

units.source_text: 对河童国机器工业的科技进步大为惊叹。

en.t: I was deeply amazed by the technological progress of the machine industry in the country of kappa.

units.source_text: 据说这家工厂一年印刷七百万部书。

en.t: It was said that this factory printed seven million books a year.

units.source_text: 不只是书的部数让我惊叹，

en.t: It was not only the number of books that astonished me,

units.source_text: 制造工艺流程的简单便利更让我大为吃惊。

en.t: but even more the simplicity and convenience of the manufacturing process.

units.source_text: 因为河童国生产书，

en.t: For in the country of kappa, to produce books,

units.source_text: 只需要把纸张、油墨和灰色的粉末倒进机器的漏斗形洞口里就大功告成了。

en.t: all one had to do was pour paper, ink, and gray powder into the funnel-shaped opening of a machine, and the work was done.

units.source_text: 原料进入机器后不足五分钟，

en.t: Less than five minutes after the raw materials entered the machine,

units.source_text: 就直接生产出了二十三开、三十二开、四十六开等各种版式的书籍。

en.t: books in all kinds of formats, such as twenty-three-mo, thirty-two-mo, and forty-six-mo, were produced directly.

units.source_text: 我看着如瀑布般倾泻而出各种各样的书籍。

en.t: I watched all kinds of books pouring out like a waterfall.

units.source_text: 我问那位趾高气扬的河童工程师灰色粉末是什么。

en.t: I asked that self-important kappa engineer what the gray powder was.

units.source_text: 他站在黑漆漆的机器前，

en.t: He stood in front of the pitch-black machine,

units.source_text: 漫不经心的回答说：“你是说这个吗？

en.t: and answered casually, "Do you mean this?

units.source_text: 这是驴的脑浆。

en.t: This is donkey brain pulp.

units.source_text: 只需要烘干制成粉末就成。

en.t: It only has to be dried and made into powder.

units.source_text: 现在的价格是是每吨两三分钱。”

en.t: The current price is two or three cents per ton."
